title: Second gradient of strain and surface-tension in linear elasticity
venue_pages: International Journal of Solids and Structures 1:417-438
what_it_establishes: Energy density depends on strain and its first and second gradients (eq. 1); full quadratic form with lambda, mu, a1-a5, b1-b7, c1-c3 (eq. 19); stress modified by the strain gradient (eq. 20a); internal length fixed by l^2 = a/mu (p.422).
limitation: No temperature field anywhere: it shows the elastic operator changes, it cannot show that G(s) is untouched.

authors: Mindlin, R. D. & Eshel, N. N.
title: On first strain-gradient theories in linear elasticity
venue_pages: International Journal of Solids and Structures 4:109-124
what_it_establishes: Abstract states that three forms of the first strain-gradient theory are compared and that the stresses and boundary conditions differ between the forms.
limitation: Abstract only; used as a corroborating remark, not as an equation source.

authors: Oh, J. H.; Kwon, Y. E.; Lee, H. J. & Kim, Y. Y.
title: Elastic metamaterials for independent realization of negativity in density and stiffness
what_it_establishes: Effective mass m_eff = m1 + m3 w^2/(wx^2 - w^2) (eq. 4a) is frequency dependent and negative above the local resonance; continuum density rho_eff = m_eff/(d h^2) on p.5.
limitation: Not in refs_P8; supports the general statement, not Liu 2000 specifically.

authors: Hobiny, A.; Abbas, I. & Marin, M.
title: The influences of the hyperbolic two-temperatures theory on waves propagation in a semiconductor material containing spherical cavity
what_it_establishes: Carrier equation (eq. 2) sits beside a heat-conduction equation carrying the relaxation operator (1 + tau0 d/dt) (eq. 3), which survives non-dimensionalisation (eq. 8).
limitation: Photothermal semiconductor: no piezoelectric term, so it verifies the semiconductor half only.

authors: Gupta, V.; Hussain, S. M.; Yaylaci, M. & Das, S.
title: Heat map analysis of wave dynamics in nonlocal Kelvin-Voigt piezo-semiconductors under memory-dependent heat flux
equations_verified_with_page: 1.1 (p.3); 1.2 (p.3); 2.1 (p.4); field equations referred to as (3.1)-(3.5) on p.9 - numbers NOT verified
